meaning: Go back and get it — learn from the past to build the future
note: From the Akan proverb “Se wo were firi na wosan kofa a, yenkyiri”: it is not taboo to go back for what you have forgotten. Drawn as a bird with its feet forward and its head turned back.
references: Carter G. Woodson Center, Berea College — “The Power of Sankofa: Know History”, https://www.berea.edu/centers/carter-g-woodson-center-for-interracial-education/the-power-of-sankofa
